Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.replication

Class AbstractReplicationService<CONFIG extends AbstractReplicationConfig,​PROCESS extends AbstractReplicationService.ReplicationProcess>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.replication.AbstractReplicationService<CONFIG,​PROCESS>
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ReleaseChangeEventListener
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    InPlacePublisherService
    public abstract class AbstractReplicationService<CONFIG extends AbstractReplicationConfig,​PROCESS extends AbstractReplicationService.ReplicationProcess>
extends Object
implements ReleaseChangeEventListener
    Base class for services that use the ReplicatorStrategy to replicate staged content. This applies to both in-place replication on the current server, as well as to remote replication.

    • Method Detail

      • processesFor

        @NotNull
public @NotNull Collection<PROCESS> processesFor​(@Nullable
                                                 @Nullable Release release)
        Description copied from interface: ReleaseChangeEventListener
        Collection of ReleaseChangeProcesses that should be run in background upon receiving events for the release. This is usually an alternative to ReleaseChangeEventListener.receive(ReleaseChangeEvent) for things that can take more time than a request should take. If this returns some processes, they are ReleaseChangeProcess.triggerProcessing(ReleaseChangeEvent) with the events and then ReleaseChangeProcess#run().
        Specified by:
        processesFor in interface ReleaseChangeEventListener
